items.title: How many users a bug reaches at each canary percentage
items.description: This reproduces L3's usersAffectedByBug calculation for a pool of 100,000 users, assuming the bug affects every user routed to the new version. It's the concrete version of "progressive delivery doesn't prevent the bug, it limits exposure to it" — the same bug, radically different blast radius depending only on what percentage of traffic reached it before being caught.
